archimate:ValueStream.name: VS-04.5 Validate and Document Results
archimate:ValueStream.documentation:
Finally, all results must be validated and documented before being used or shared. This includes checking whether estimates and models meet quality standards, reviewing for plausibility, and comparing results against external benchmarks or historical data. Quality indicators — such as standard errors, confidence intervals, or R² values — are calculated and attached to each result. If anomalies are found, the results are revised or annotated to explain them. Once validated, the outputs are documented with detailed metadata that describes the methodology, assumptions, and quality measures. This documentation ensures transparency, reproducibility, and trust in the published results.
Value created: Reliable and validated analytical results ready for composition, interpretation, and dissemination.
